Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(sum(g,[])); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def bands(sizes,n):
        # n separators, return start/end pairs covering cells between them
        idxs=[-1]+list(sizes)+[h-n] if sizes else None
        res=[]
        p=-1
        for x in sizes+[n]:
            if x>p: res.append((p+1,x))
            p=x
        return res
    rbands=bands(rows,h-len(rows)); cbands=bands(cols,w-len(cols))
    for a,b in rbands:
        for c,d in cbands:
            cells=[g[i][j] for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d)]
            ac=[v for v in cells if v!=bg]
            av=Counter(ac).most_common(1)[0][0] if ac else bg
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(c,d):
                    out[i][j]=av
    return out

from collections import Counter
import json,os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); di=[[1,1,1,1,8,1,2,1,1],[2,1,1,1,8,1,2,1,1],[8]*9,[1,1,2,1,8,1,1,1,1],[1,1,1,1,8,2,1,2,1],[8]*9,[1,1,1,1,8,1,1,1,1],[2,1,1,2,8,1,1,1,2]]
do=[[1,1,1,1,8,2,2,2,2],[1,1,1,1,8,2,2,2,2],[8]*9,[1,1,1,1,8,2,2,2,2],[1,1,1,1,8,2,2,2,2],[8]*9,[2,2,2,2,8,1,1,1,1],[2,2,2,2,8,1,1,1,1]]
ti=G['Test input']
# Try rule: fill accent if count>=2, else keep bg; separator cells unchanged. Test my earlier grid vs this exact f; also try threshold 1.
def f(g,k):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(sum(g,[])); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    sep=g[rows[0]][0]
    ac=[v for v in set(sum(g,[])) if v!=bg and v!=sep][0]
    def bands(s,n):
        p=-1; res=[]
        for x in s+[n]:
            if x>p+1: res.append((p+1,x)); p=x
        return res
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for a,b in bands(rows,h):
        for c,d in bands(cols,w):
            n=sum(1 for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if g[i][j]==ac)
            val = ac if n>=k else bg
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(c,d): out[i][j]=val
    return out

res=f(ti,2); print(json.dumps(res))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def runs(idx,N):
    out=[]; seg=None
    for x in idx+[N]:
        if seg is None: seg=[x]
        elif x==seg[-1]+1: seg.append(x)
        else: out.append((seg[0],seg[-1])); seg=[x]
    if seg: out.append((seg[0],N))
    return out
def analyze(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(sum(g,[])); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Rs=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    Cs=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    sep=g[Rs[0]][0] if Rs else None
    ac=[v for v in set(sum(g,[])) if v!=bg and v!=sep][0]
    RB=runs(Rs,h); CB=runs(Cs,w)
    counts=[[sum(1 for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if g[i][j]==ac) for c,d in CB] for a,b in RB]
    fill=[[all(ggo[i][j]==ac for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d)) for c,d in CB] for a,b in RB]
    return counts,fill,RB,CB,ac,bg,sep
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi,go=G[p+' input'],G[p+' output']
    C,F,RB,CB,ac,bg,sep=analyze(gi)
    print(p,'counts',C,'fills',F,'RB',RB,'CB',CB)

def intervals(seps,n):
    pts=[-1]+seps+[n]; out=[]
    for i in range(len(pts)-1):
        if pts[i+1]>pts[i]: out.append((pts[i]+1,pts[i+1]))
    return out

def solve(maj_tie='right'):
    def f(gi):
        g=[row[:] for row in gi]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
        cnt=Counter(sum(g,[])); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
        sep=g[rs[0]][0]
        ac=[v for v in set(sum(g,[])) if v!=bg and v!=sep][0]
        # horizontal separators -> row bands
        hr=intervals(rs,h)
        # vertical separators -> col groups
        vc=intervals(cs,w)
        # assign each column group to a row-band: count ac cells; pick per band
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for a,b in hr:
            best=None
            for c,d in vc:
                n=sum(1 for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if g[i][j]==ac)
                key=(-n if maj_tie=='min' else n, c)
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,c,d)
            _,c,d=best
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(c,d):
                    if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=ac
        return out
    ok=True
    for p in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,7)]:
        if f(G[p+' input'])!=G[p+' output']:
            ok=False; print(p,'MISMATCH')
            break
    else: print('ALL MATCH'); return f

def blocks(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(sum(gi,[])); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(gi[r]))==1]; cs=[c for c in range(w) if len({gi[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    sep=gi[rs[0]][0]; ac=[v for v in set(sum(gi,[])) if v!=bg and v!=sep][0]
    Rb=intervals(rs,h); Cb=intervals(cs,w)
    return bg,ac,rs,cs,Rb,Cb

for p in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,8)]:

            a=[b[0] for b in Rb if b[0]<=r<b[1]]
